current_evidence: The 'Make a planning application' page (last updated 22 July 2026) links no local validation list or checklist. Searches found no unified North Northamptonshire local list. The only list on planning.data.gov.uk is the legacy Corby Borough Council 'Validation Check List For Planning Applications' (Development Control Committee, 27 November 2018), which suggests the predecessor-area lists still apply.

issues.detail: Grokbot's URL is a general guidance page, 'Supporting documents and reports' (last updated 19 May 2023), not an adopted local validation list. It gives triggers only for the Design and Access Statement, Heritage Impact Assessment and Tree Survey, and lists the other documents as needed 'depending on the application'. The workbook should say no unified local list was found and check the legacy Corby, Kettering, East Northamptonshire and Wellingborough area lists (e.g. Corby's 2018 'Validation Check List For Planning Applications').
issues.evidence: Page has no link to a validation list or checklist; 'Last updated 19 May 2023'

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only 5 items. The page itself names more documents that may be required: Air quality assessment, Archaeological assessment, Biodiversity survey and report, Crime impact assessment, Flood risk assessment, S106 Heads of terms, Housing statement, Land contamination assessment, Landscaping details, Lighting assessment, Noise assessment, Odour impact assessment, Photographs, Statement of community involvement, Structural survey, Supporting planning statement, Sustainability appraisal and energy statement, Town centre uses, Transport assessment/statement, Travel plan, Tree survey / arboricultural implications ('if your property has any trees') and Utilities assessment. The parent page also adds Fire statements and the Upper Nene Valley SPA mitigation contribution (net new dwellings within 5.9km of the SPA).
issues.evidence: 'Documents' list on the Supporting documents and reports page

issues.detail: Most tab_items are not requirements: 'you can submit applications by email, on a disc or hard copy', 'requires only one original of any form', the 'Biodiversity Metric 4.0 is a biodiversity accounting tool' description, 'subject to an £85 administration fee', and four SPA background sentences (classification in 2011, 1358 hectares, SPA and Ramsar boundaries identical, 'References to the SPA should therefore be interpreted...').

The Full planning 'Block plan / Site plan' trigger is navigation text ('location and block plans Plan and drawing requirements Supporting documents and reports ... Other reports will be needed'). The Heritage Statement excerpt runs into the Tree Survey text. 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' quotes SPD guidance with no trigger.

'Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) information / metric' is placed under Householder, but the excerpt says the opposite: householder applications are excepted. The Design and Access Statement appears only under Listed building consent, although it also applies to major development and to dwellings or buildings of 100 sqm+ in conservation areas (Full/Outline).
issues.evidence: 'All applications (except householder applications such as extensions, and de minimis habitats) will need to complete a Biodiversity Net Gain metric'

issues.detail: Status is 'Captured' with 'Partial (automated)' extraction and an undated list. This overstates things: no adopted local validation list was identified for the authority.

summary: Grokbot's link works but is a generic 2023 'supporting documents' guidance page, not a local validation list. I found no unified North Northamptonshire list (legacy area lists such as Corby's 2018 checklist appear to apply). Even against that page, Grokbot missed about 20 listed documents and captured mostly process and background text.
